title: Envelope
description: Shared envelope carried in EventBridge `detail` for every message on the domain bus. EventBridge `detail-type` equals `type` and `source` is the stable producing service name.

id.description: Unique message id (UUID v4). Consumers deduplicate on this.

kind.description: Whether the message states a fact (event) or requests work (command).

type.description: Message type name, e.g. PaymentReceived or ReconcileInvoice.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the data schema for this type.

occurredAt.description: When the underlying business fact occurred (UTC, RFC 3339).

correlationId.description: Shared by every message produced while handling one inbound third-party event.

causationId.description: Id of the message or event that directly caused this one.

source.description: The third-party event id this message was derived from.

synthetic.description: True for smoke-test traffic. Consumers must treat it as non-production data.

data.description: Type-specific payload. Constrained by the per-type schema.
